en.headline: Immigration Department breaks cross-border fake identity syndicate, 15 held
en.dek: Officers arrested two ringleaders who were later sentenced to 29 and 42 months in jail after a scheme that supplied forged Hong Kong identity cards to illegal workers.
body: The Immigration Department said it dismantled a cross-border syndicate that arranged forged Hong Kong identity cards and accommodation for illegal workers from the mainland, arresting 15 people in total.

The operation, codenamed Reveal, began after officers intercepted a mainland visitor with a crude forged identity card at Lok Ma Chau in January 2024. The group had charged high intermediary fees, then persuaded victims to work illegally in Hong Kong while providing fake documents or mobile images of them.

Two ringleaders were sentenced to 29 and 42 months’ imprisonment for offences including conspiracy to make false instruments and assisting others to breach conditions of stay. Ten illegal workers received sentences of 12 to 15 months. Officers seized five physical forged identity cards and more than 40 electronic images.

zh.headline: 入境處破跨境偽證黑工集團 拘15人
zh.dek: 兩名主腦因安排偽造香港身份證及住宿予非法勞工，分別被判囚29及42個月。
body: 入境事務處表示，搞破一個跨境集團，專門安排偽造香港身份證及住宿予來自內地的非法勞工，行動中共拘捕15人。
行動代號「顯影」，源於2024年1月在落馬洲截查一名持粗糙偽造身份證的內地旅客。集團先收取高額中介費，後以簽證問題為由勸說受害人來港非法工作，並提供假證或手機上的偽造證件圖片。
兩名主腦因串謀製造虛假文書及協助他人違反逗留條件等罪，分別被判監禁29及42個月；10名黑工判囚12至15個月。處方檢獲5張實體偽造身份證及超過40張電子圖片。
